meta.title: Codefix add missing function declaration inserts function in wrong file
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#59213 (fix(59116): Codefix add missing function declaration inserts function in wrong file), 7319968e90, 2024-07-25; git tag --contains: first in v5.6-rc / v5.6.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@5.5.4 (2024-07-22) and typescript@5.6.2 (2024-09-09), both behind typescript-language-server@4.3.3 (the latest wrapper release before 5.6.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session.
meta.notes: The maintainer's trace shows the pre-fix edit targets the file being edited (index.ts/main.ts) at a position computed in lib.ts, possibly beyond the end of main.ts.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project for the open file and its import.

repro.steps: Open main.ts: 'X.foobar()' is reported (TS2339, foobar does not exist on typeof X). Apply the quick fix "Add missing function declaration 'foobar'". Reported: the function is inserted into main.ts (the wrong file) instead of into namespace X in lib.ts, so the error stays. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited files must neither report the targeted TS2339 nor a new error.
